footnote_text: The reporting person contributed Guardant Health common stock to an exchange fund in exchange for 9,400 units of the exchange fund.  The Guardant Health common stock was valued at $145.14 per share for the purpose of determining the amount of 13,892,952 units of the exchange fund issuable to the reporting person.
